Seventh pre-release of 1.4 — more of **Bookends** on its page, the **subtitle in Bookshelf's top panel**, plus small fixes. Linux and macOS only (as before).

## New

- **Bookends — show on odd or even pages:** each line can be limited to odd or even pages (for example page numbers on the outer side).
- **Bookends — bars inside a line:** *Insert bar* adds the `%bar` token to the selected line; then chapter or book, chapter ticks, style, fill direction and thickness (read and unread) can be set. Colours and markers of a bar stay as they are.
- **Bookends — progress bars:** a new section for the up to eight bars across the page: on/off, chapter or book, chapter ticks, style, fill direction, edge, thickness (diameter for round bars), distance from the edge and margins. Colours, markers and *Position relative to line text* are kept and still set on the e-reader.
- **Subtitle in Bookshelf's top panel:** new KOReader patch `2-bookbench-subtitle.lua` — attached to this release, or added from the *Patches* page in Bookbench. It reads the subtitle and calibre's custom columns straight from each EPUB on the e-reader: Bookshelf gets the token `%subtitle`, and `%calibre{name}` in Bookshelf and Bookends works without calibre's `metadata.calibre`. Copy it into `koreader/patches/` and restart KOReader.
- **Bookshelf — top panel:** choose between the current book (hero card) and modules, and edit the lines of the hero card (text with tokens, size, alignment, bold, capitals; which tags to show). *Subtitle* puts `%subtitle` into a line.
- **Bookshelf — modules, start menu, shelves:** add and place the modules of the top panel, rearrange the start menu (folders, dividers, modules, Bookshelf's standard entries; rename, move into folders), and show/hide, reorder, rename shelves or change how they are shown. Removed standard shelves can be added back.
- **Swiping in the workbench:** drag with the mouse to swipe; the mouse wheel turns pages on the reading page and scrolls on the start screen (Shift for sideways).

## Fixed

- **Bookshelf's top area (hero card)** now shows the book read last (or the selected book) instead of staying empty.
- *Choose …* buttons in the settings dialog are no longer cut off.
- English interface: the menu shortcuts no longer clash (*E-reader* is now Alt+R), and the *Parts* column on the E-reader page scrolls instead of being cut off.

## Install

- **Linux:** *Help > Check for updates* in an installed copy (with *Settings > Updates > Include pre-releases* on), or `install.sh` from this repository.
- **Windows:** `Bookbench_Setup_1.4-beta7.exe` (not signed yet: SmartScreen > *More info* > *Run anyway*). The Preview area does not exist on Windows.
